required_validation_gates: All source file hashes, model identities, prompt, media, image grid, configuration, and decoding settings must match the frozen Stage 3 evidence.

The row-3 pair must have the same description, syntax, token count, and strict physical owner 1509406 and differ only at the four coordinate-token positions.
The row-4 pair must have the same description, syntax, token count, and strict physical owner 1506295 and differ only at the x1 coordinate-token position.
Rows 5 and 6 must be exact raw-token matches in all four arms and must retain strict owners 1620693 and 1571233 respectively.
Neither frozen row-7 candidate may occur inside any forced prefix.
The native-row-three plus native-row-four endpoint must reproduce the exact frozen native row-7 token identifiers and owner 1571077.
The sampled-row-three plus sampled-row-four endpoint must reproduce the exact frozen sampled target row-7 token identifiers and owner 678023.
Each arm must generate exactly one accepted complete row and stop without appending it for any further generation.
primary_outcome: The strict physical owner of the one generated row 7, classified as native owner 1571077, sampled target owner 678023, another strict owner, or unresolved.
secondary_outcomes: Exact raw-token reproduction for both frozen endpoints.
